                     │\n│  Location: (Not yet implemented)                           │\n│                                                         │\n│  Sample first 1 MB of file to detect compressibility:    │\n│  ├─ Read sample chunk                                     │\n│  ├─ CompressionStream compress                            │\n│  └─ If ratio < 0.9 → enable compression                   │\n│                                                         │\n│  Decision factors:                                         │\n│  ├─ Skip if already compressed (detected by magic)       │\n│
